sources.title: monday.com to lay off 620, as it adapts to AI
sources.description: The Israeli work operating systems company is laying off 20% of its workforce, including 350 employees in Tel Aviv.

sources.title: Monday.com is cutting 20 percent of its workforce as it pivots to an AI work platform
sources.description: Monday.com will lay off about 620 employees and flatten its management structure as the project management company chases what it calls the AI Work Platform

sources.title: Monday.com cuts 20% of workforce as it restructures for the AI era | CTech
sources.description: The Israeli software company says it is replacing a structure built around managing work with one designed for AI agents and human collaboration, cutting about 620 jobs while redirecting resources toward its new strategy.
